# LangGraph

## Start Here

- [Quickstart](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/quickstart): Build a chatbot that can use tools and keep track of conversation history.
- [LangGraph Overview](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/overview): Gain control with LangGraph to design agents that reliably handle complex tasks.
- [Workflows + agents](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/workflows-agents): Compare workflow and agent design patterns.

## Core Concepts

- [Thinking in LangGraph](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/thinking-in-langgraph): High-level framing for LangGraph.
- [Graph API](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/graph-api): Build and compose graphs.
- [Functional API](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/functional-api): Use `@entrypoint` and `@task`-style patterns.
- [Persistence](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/persistence): Persist state across runs.
- [Durable execution](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/durable-execution): Recover and resume long-running workflows.
- [Streaming](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/streaming): Stream state, tokens, and events.
- [Interrupts](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/interrupts): Add human-in-the-loop control.
- [Time travel](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/use-time-travel): Replay past runs and inspect state.
- [Memory](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/add-memory): Add short-term and long-term memory.
- [Subgraphs](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/use-subgraphs): Reuse nested graphs.

## Production

- [Application structure](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/application-structure): Organize LangGraph apps for deployment.
- [Test](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/test): Validate deployments locally.
- [LangSmith Studio](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/studio): Visualize, test, and debug your graphs.
- [Agent Chat UI](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/ui): Render LangGraph agents in the frontend.
- [LangSmith Deployment](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/deploy): Deploy and scale agents.
- [LangSmith Observability](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/observability): Trace and monitor agent behavior.

## Frontend

- [Overview](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/frontend/overview): Render LangGraph agents to the frontend.
- [Graph execution](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/frontend/graph-execution): Understand frontend rendering and execution flow.

## Troubleshooting

- [Common Errors](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/common-errors): Resolve common LangGraph errors.
